interpretation_rule: B17: accelerator/brake/steering channels are not driver-only; no human-input inference

populations.RAW: every simulator CSV in the archive
populations.TOR_PRESENT: TOR column present in the file header
populations.TOR_ANCHORED: TOR anchor resolved (single value, or unique value at TTC 7.0 ± 0.25 s)
populations.OWNER_WINDOW_ELIGIBLE: TOR_ANCHORED and lane change VALIDATED against lane_id and TOR < lane change (owners' published window; not handback-bounded)
populations.MANUAL_WINDOW_ELIGIBLE: TOR_ANCHORED and single Manual_Start and handback defined and TOR < handback and Manual_Start < handback
populations.OWNER_ANALYSIS_SET: UNKNOWN / NOT RECONSTRUCTED (owner per-trial list not public)

windows.POST_TOR_MANUAL: [TOR, handback) where handback = first Manual_Stop after Manual_Start
windows.OWNER_TOR_TO_LANE_CHANGE: [TOR, validated lane change] as published by the owners; requires OWNER_WINDOW_ELIGIBLE; not handback-bounded
windows.MANUAL_TOR_TO_LANE_CHANGE: [TOR, validated lane change] with lane change < handback; requires LANE_CHANGE_ANCHORED

unresolved_semantic_dependencies: B17: accelerator, brake and steering channel authorship (automation / simulator / driver / mixed) UNRESOLVED
B6: brake channel physical meaning and unit UNRESOLVED
B7: Manual_Start as authority transfer UNRESOLVED (used only as a button/event marker)
B14: meaning of additional Manual_Stop values UNRESOLVED
B12: owners' 466-trial analysis set NOT RECONSTRUCTED

outputs.event_and_vehicle_state_metrics.csv: RAW rows; t_button for TOR_ANCHORED; owner_* for OWNER_WINDOW_ELIGIBLE; manual_* for LANE_CHANGE_ANCHORED
outputs.control_channel_observations.csv: MANUAL_WINDOW_ELIGIBLE; windows: pre-TOR [TOR-4, TOR-0.2], post-TOR [TOR, TOR+0.3), POST_TOR_MANUAL, OWNER_TOR_TO_LANE_CHANGE
outputs.channel_activity_diagnostics.csv: MANUAL_WINDOW_ELIGIBLE; one row per trial x window (POST_TOR_MANUAL, POST_BUTTON_MANUAL and two historical comparators); authorship UNRESOLVED (B17)
